name: Cal.com
summary: Scheduling tool with shareable booking pages, Cal Video, workflows and Stripe payments on a free plan, with round-robin and routing for teams.
best_for: freelancers, consultants and small teams that want a shareable booking page with video calls and email confirmations, starting on a free plan
skip_if: you need calendar sync proven for your calendar before you commit, or you want text reminders at a known price per message
honest_knock: Team features such as round-robin, collective events, routing forms and removing the Cal.com branding need a paid plan. SMS reminders use prepaid credits and the price per text is not shown. In our test the app stayed in Dutch until we changed the language to another one and back, and the default links were created in Dutch. We did not test calendar sync.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-22 on cal.com/pricing, USD) Individuals: free forever. Teams: $12 per user a month billed yearly (25% saving), $16 billed monthly. Organizations: $28 per user a month billed yearly, $37 billed monthly. Enterprise: custom pricing. SMS and AI calls are paid with prepaid credits, one credit is worth 1 cent (billing page, 21 November 2026); the price per text message is not shown. The Stripe app is free to install and Stripe charges its own fees.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 21 November 2026 in the Cal.com web app on the free Individual plan, with the interface switched to English. We went through onboarding, made a 30 minute event type with Cal Video, booked a slot on its public page as a visitor, read the confirmation email and then cancelled the booking. We also opened the plans screen, the workflows page and the Stripe app page and stopped before any payment. From the first onboarding screen to a confirmed booking took about 3 minutes.
findings: Onboarding: four screens (plan choice, booking link, calendar connection, video). We chose the free personal plan, skipped the calendar connection and kept Cal Video as the default. No card and no phone number were asked.
Event type: a 30 minute event type with the default Cal Video location took three steps. Its public page showed open slots from 9:00 to 16:30 on weekdays without any availability setup.

Booking: choosing a slot and confirming took about one minute. The confirmation page said "This meeting is scheduled" and the confirmation email reached the inbox within seconds. Cancelling took two clicks and an optional reason, and the cancellation email arrived about three seconds later.
Language: the app stayed in Dutch although the language setting already said English, and so did the default links it created. It switched only after we changed the language to another one and back.

Free plan: Workflows with email and SMS reminder templates and the Stripe app were available without an upgrade prompt. SMS and AI calls are paid with credits, one credit is worth 1 cent, and the price per text message was not shown. Stripe charges its own fees.

Plans: the plans screen listed Team at $16 and Organization at $37 per user a month on monthly billing ($12 and $28 billed yearly), and Enterprise on request. Upgrade to Business opened a Create a new team wizard rather than a payment screen, and we stopped there.
not_tested: Not tested: calendar sync. We connected no calendar, so we cannot say how well it prevents double bookings.
Not tested: a real Cal Video call, paid bookings through Stripe, SMS reminders and teams or round-robin events.
Not tested: paying for a plan. We did not complete the team wizard that follows Upgrade to Business, so we have not seen a payment screen.
